content:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Primary endpoint analysis not fully specified",
      "quote": "The primary efficacy endpoint for this study is the ORR as determined by central review.",
      "page": 34,
      "section": "4.2.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The primary endpoint ORR is defined, but the statistical analysis section does not specify the exact analysis method (e.g., exact binomial CI) for the primary endpoint, nor the estimand attributes (population, variable, intercurrent events, summary measure) beyond the definition.",
      "fix": "Add a detailed statistical analysis for the primary endpoint including the estimand, analysis method, and handling of intercurrent events."
    },
    {
      "title": "Secondary endpoints lack analysis details",
      "quote": "The secondary endpoints are: • Duration of response • PFS • OS • CR rate • Change in scores of patient-reported outcomes in the EORTC QLQ-C30 and the Skindex-16 • AEs • Concentrations of cemiplimab in serum (at select sites) • Anti-cemiplimab antibodies",
      "page": 34,
      "section": "4.2.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The secondary endpoints are listed, but the statistical plan does not describe how each will be analyzed (e.g., Kaplan-Meier for DOR/PFS/OS, mixed models for PROs, descriptive for AEs/PK/ADA).",
      "fix": "Provide analysis methods for each secondary endpoint in the statistical plan."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing estimand attributes for primary endpoint",
      "quote": "The primary objective of the study is to estimate the ORR for metastatic BCC (Group 1) or unresectable locally advanced BCC (Group 2), according to central review, when treated with cemiplimab monotherapy in patients who have progressed on HHI therapy, or were intolerant of prior HHI therapy",
      "page": 31,
      "section": "2.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The estimand for the primary endpoint is not fully specified: the population is described, but the variable (ORR) is defined, yet intercurrent events (e.g., death, new therapy) and summary measure (proportion) are not explicitly stated in the statistical plan.",
      "fix": "Define the estimand for ORR including intercurrent event handling and summary measure."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing handling of missing data for primary endpoint",
      "quote": "Patients who are deemed not evaluable by RECIST version 1.1 (Group 1; Appendix 1) or by the composite response criteria (Group 2; Appendix 2) will be considered as not reaching PR/CR for ORR.",
      "page": 34,
      "section": "4.2.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol states that not evaluable patients are considered non-responders, but does not address other missing data scenarios (e.g., missing tumor assessments, early discontinuation) for the primary endpoint or other endpoints.",
      "fix": "Specify the handling of all missing data for primary and secondary endpoints."
    },
    {
      "title": "No multiplicity control for secondary endpoints",
      "quote": "The secondary endpoints are: • Duration of response • PFS • OS • CR rate • Change in scores of patient-reported outcomes in the EORTC QLQ-C30 and the Skindex-16 • AEs • Concentrations of cemiplimab in serum (at select sites) • Anti-cemiplimab antibodies",
      "page": 34,
      "section": "4.2.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The statistical plan does not mention any adjustment for multiplicity when testing multiple secondary endpoints, which could inflate the type I error.",
      "fix": "Add a section on multiplicity control for secondary endpoints."
    },
    {
      "title": "Sample size inconsistency for Group 2",
      "quote": "For Group 2, 80 patients are required to provide at least 95% power to reject a null hypothesis of an ORR of 20% at a 2-sided significance level of 5% if the true ORR is 35%.",
      "page": 82,
      "section": "10.2",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The text says 80 patients are required, but later says 'The sample sizes will be further increased by 5% to account for patients who withdraw prematurely from the study. Hence, the total sample sizes will be 53 patients for Group 1 and 84 patients for Group 2' – 80*1.05=84, consistent, but the initial statement of 80 is the pre-inflation number; no inconsistency found, but the power calculation is based on 80, not 84, which is fine. However, the text says 'at least 95% power' and the table title says 'Based on 95% Power' – consistent. No issue.",
      "fix": "No fix needed."
    },
    {
      "title": "Exploratory objectives limited to Group 2 only",
      "quote": "The exploratory objectives (for Group 2 only) are to explore the pharmacodynamic effects of cemiplimab in tumor biopsies obtained at baseline, during treatment, and at progression in BCC patients treated with cemiplimab",
      "page": 31,
      "section": "2.3",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The exploratory objectives are stated as Group 2 only, but the exploratory endpoints in Section 4.2.3 do not specify Group 2 only, which could be ambiguous.",
      "fix": "Clarify whether exploratory endpoints apply to both groups or only Group 2."
    },
    {
      "title": "No analysis for exploratory endpoints",
      "quote": "The following exploratory analyses are planned: • Associations between tumor non-synonymous mutational burden at baseline and efficacy • Pharmacodynamic changes, comparing baseline and on-treatment biopsies:",
      "page": 35,
      "section": "4.2.3",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The exploratory endpoints are listed, but the statistical plan does not describe any analysis methods for these endpoints.",
      "fix": "Add analysis methods for exploratory endpoints in the statistical plan."
    }
  ]
}
